title: Three Questions Before Choosing An App
description: Synthetic demo: original decision framework, not current research or a factual video.

scenes.headline: Does it solve something real?
scenes.narration: Before choosing a new tool, consider the outcome that actually matters. A great feature list is no substitute for solving a recurring problem.

scenes.headline: Compare it fairly
scenes.narration: Test one practical task using your current workflow and the proposed alternative. Keep the criteria consistent, and write down where each approach creates extra work.

scenes.headline: Check the hidden friction
scenes.narration: Review the time required to learn a new tool and the manual cleanup it creates. Convenience depends on the full workflow, not just an impressive demonstration.

scenes.headline: Choose evidence over hype
scenes.narration: Repeat the comparison before you commit. Favor the option that produces reliable results with less effort for your specific needs.
